description: Is a short Yet2-like paralogue a general feature of Saccharomycetaceae, and does it carry the KKxx motif?
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
   params={'query':'xref:pfam-PF05529 AND taxonomy_id:4893','fields':'accession,organism_name,length,gene_names,sequence','format':'tsv','size':'500'},timeout=90)
rows=[l.split('\t') for l in r.text.strip().split('\n')][1:]
rows=[x for x in rows if len(x)>=5]
print('Saccharomycetaceae PF05529 entries:',len(rows))
sp=collections.Counter(x[1].split('(')[0].strip() for x in rows)
print('species:',len(sp),' entries/species median',np.median(list(sp.values())))
L=np.array([len(x[4]) for x in rows])
print('length deciles:',np.percentile(L,[10,25,50,75,90]).round(0))
short=[x for x in rows if len(x[4])<180]
print(f'\nentries <180 aa: {len(short)} ({len(short)/len(rows)*100:.0f}%)')
for x in sorted(short,key=lambda z:len(z[4]))[:25]:
    print(f"  {x[0]:12s} {x[1][:46]:48s} len={len(x[4]):4d}  gene={x[3][:28]:30s} Cterm={x[4][-6:]}")
# how many species have >=3 paralogues (Yet1/Yet2/Yet3-like) and of those how many include a short one
bysp=collections.defaultdict(list)
for x in rows: bysp[x[1].split('(')[0].strip()].append(x)
multi={k:v for k,v in bysp.items() if len(v)>=3}
withshort=[k for k,v in multi.items() if any(len(e[4])<180 for e in v)]
print(f"\nspecies with >=3 PF05529 paralogues: {len(multi)}; of these, with a <180 aa paralogue: {len(withshort)}")
print('  examples:',withshort[:10])
# di-lysine motif check across family
def kkxx(s): return s[-4]=='K' and s[-3]=='K'
print(f"\nC-terminal KKxx among Saccharomycetaceae PF05529: {sum(kkxx(x[4]) for x in rows)}/{len(rows)}")
print(f"  among <180 aa:  {sum(kkxx(x[4]) for x in short)}/{len(short)}")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.2))
ax.hist(L,bins=40,color='#9bb7d4',edgecolor='w')
ax.axvline(160,color='crimson',ls='--',lw=2); ax.text(162,ax.get_ylim()[1]*.8,'Yet2p 160 aa',color='crimson',fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(203,color='#2e7d32',ls='--',lw=2); ax.text(205,ax.get_ylim()[1]*.6,'Yet3p 203',color='#2e7d32',fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(206,color='#1f4e79',ls=':',lw=2)
ax.set_xlabel('protein length (aa)'); ax.set_ylabel('entries')
ax.set_title(f'Saccharomycetaceae BAP31-family (Pfam PF05529, n={len(rows)}) length distribution',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
